earnings.title: Kimberly-Clark Announces Third Quarter Results, Reaffirms 2026 Standalone Outlook
highlights: Delivered net sales of $4.1 billion, down 0.4 percent, while organic sales declined 1.3 percent.
Diluted earnings per share ("EPS") from continuing operations were $1.19; adjusted EPS from continuing operations were $1.70, up 17.2 percent versus the prior year.
Diluted EPS attributable to Kimberly-Clark were $5.37; adjusted EPS attributable to Kimberly-Clark were $1.70, down 6.6 percent versus the prior year.

Net sales of $4.1 billion were relatively flat compared to the prior year, as favorable impacts from sales recognized under supply agreements with the Arbex Joint Venture and favorable currency impacts were largely offset by a
Gross margin was 34.9 percent; adjusted gross margin was 35.5 percent, down 130 basis points versus the prior year.

quotes.text: The completion of our Kenvue transaction earlier this week marks a defining moment in the 154 year history of Kimberly-Clark. We embark on an exciting next chapter focused on delivering better care, in more hands, and enabling smarter health.
quotes.by: Kimberly-Clark Chairman and CEO Mike Hsu

outlook: The company continues to expect 2026 Organic Sales Growth to be approximately 100 basis points below its weighted average category growth in the categories and countries it competes, which is approximately 1.7 percent on a trailing twelve-month basis.

items.heading: Significant increases in prices for raw materials, energy, transportation or other necessary supplies or services, without corresponding increases in our selling prices, could adversely affect our financial results.
Failure of key technology systems, cyberattacks, privacy breaches or data breaches could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations and reputation.

Our international operations are subject to foreign market risks, including changes in foreign currency exchange rates, currency restrictions, political, social and economic instability, and the imposition of increased or new tariffs, which may adversely affect our financial results.
Our operations in Russia and the surrounding region are impacted by the war in Ukraine.
Damage to the reputation of Kimberly-Clark or to one or more of our brands could adversely affect our business.
Our inability to attract and retain key personnel could adversely impact our business.
